name: Lithium BoM (dev)
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --locked && npm ci && npm run build:css && DEBUG=True SECRET_KEY=dev-secret-key uv run python manage.py migrate --noinput

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export DEBUG=True SECRET_KEY=dev-secret-key DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS="localhost 127.0.0.1 [::1]"; uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
